node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),zlib=require("node:zlib"),crypto=require("node:crypto");const root="/var/www/vhosts/gravuru-designwerkstatt.de/private",base=root+"/install-performance-followup-20261110.cjs",sha=b=>crypto.createHash("sha256").update(b).digest("hex"),gz=Buffer.from("","base64"),body=zlib.gunzipSync(gz);const expectGz="964a211db4141d3c4df1695bdafd09c9590d579af517baaafcb69f122886a529",expectBody="9aa96ac7f9cbbdc3a66a19c26e42b6621959134f1eb60b6ebe77f1cf02ab63b3";if(sha(gz)!==expectGz||sha(body)!==expectBody)throw Error("Transfer content hash mismatch");if(!fs.statSync(root).isDirectory())throw Error("Private directory missing");function save(file,bytes,expected){try{const stat=fs.lstatSync(file);if(!stat.isFile()||stat.isSymbolicLink()||sha(fs.readFileSync(file))!==expected)throw Error("Existing target differs: "+file);}catch(error){if(error.code!=="ENOENT")throw error;fs.writeFileSync(file,bytes,{flag:"wx",mode:384});}if(sha(fs.readFileSync(file))!==expected)throw Error("Transferred target verification failed");return{file,bytes:bytes.length,sha256:expected};}console.log(JSON.stringify({transferOnly:true,installerExecuted:false,files:[save(base+".gz",gz,expectGz),save(base,body,expectBody)]}));'
